# RestroPulse - AI Cost by Restaurant

Stacked-bar of LLM / image / video / sonar costs per restaurant per month. Source: Application Insights `customEvents` table where `name == 'ai.request.completed'`.

Use the time-range parameter at the top to scope the window. Costs are denormalized at write time -- if pricing tables change, historical rows reflect the rate at the time of the call.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'ai.request.completed'
| extend restaurantId = tostring(customDimensions.restaurantId)
| extend surface = tostring(customDimensions.surface)
| extend costUsd = todouble(customDimensions.costUsd)
| where isnotempty(restaurantId)
| summarize TotalUsd = round(sum(costUsd), 4) by restaurantId, surface, MonthBin = bin(timestamp, 30d)
| order by MonthBin desc, TotalUsd desc
content.title: Per-restaurant monthly cost by surface

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'ai.request.completed'
| extend restaurantId = tostring(customDimensions.restaurantId)
| extend costUsd = todouble(customDimensions.costUsd)
| where isnotempty(restaurantId)
| summarize TotalUsd = round(sum(costUsd), 4), CallCount = count() by restaurantId
| order by TotalUsd desc
content.title: Restaurant leaderboard (total cost + call count)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'ai.request.completed'
| extend surface = tostring(customDimensions.surface)
| extend costUsd = todouble(customDimensions.costUsd)
| summarize TotalUsd = round(sum(costUsd), 4) by surface, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Platform-wide daily cost by surface
